name: Villanueva de Perales (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, green above and yellow below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva de Perales (trees on yellow and chequy of blue and white).
history: The arms and flag of Villanueva de Perales were approved officially in 2003, published in the Boletín Oficial de la Comunidad de Madrid on 18 February 2003; the flag is of proportions 2/3, divided diagonally from the top of the hoist to the bottom of the fly into two parts.

features.role: Villanueva de Perales arms — trees on yellow and chequy of blue and white
